mode_evidence: The grasping sign is seen 'as it were in space'; the after-image is said to be seen with closed eyes 'only in thought' and moved at will far, near, left or right, which marks a mind-made image that is perceived rather than a retinal one.
onset_evidence: The procedure is for a beginner: prepare a mandala (dawn-coloured clay circle, or blue, yellow, red or white colour, or a bowl of water throwing light on a wall); gaze with undisturbed mind; grasping sign then arises; following it again and again the after-image arises. A new yogin must use a prepared object; the practised can grasp it in nature. Digest shows no time scale or cannot-be-forced statement; a teacher is stressed (protect the sign with reverence for the teacher).

conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: Even gazing, skilfulness and the elimination of disturbance; mandala at proper distance.
conditions.setting: Calm place, screened from sun, one fathom from the mandala; for the light kasina a wall facing east or west with a bowl of water in the sun.
conditions.duration_and_schedule: Repeatedly; increase size from a span and four fingers.
conditions.prerequisites: Consider the tribulations of sense-desires and the benefits of renunciation first.

stages.label: grasping sign
stages.description: Mandala perceived as if in space, sometimes far, near, left, right, big, small, ugly, lovely.

stages.label: after-image
stages.description: Arises through following the grasping sign again and again; seen with closed eyes and placed at will in any direction.

stages.label: increase of the kasina
stages.description: In access or first jhana expand the sign step by step to a wheel, field, village, city, the whole earth.

what_to_do_with_light: Protect the sign with reverence for the teacher; refrain from evil, do good, keep up endeavour; do not scan the mandala; once the after-image is stable, expand it gradually.
obstacles_and_fixes: Mind moving in one direction: the sign can be made to arise.
A new yogin cannot take the sign in an unprepared place and should use a prepared mandala.
cautions: If the sign is not protected it will surely be lost.
interpretation: The sign and after-image are mind-born objects of concentration leading to jhana; the light kasina yields seeing light everywhere.
practice_summary: Make a circle of dawn-coloured clay in a calm, screened place, or a colour mandala for the colour kasinas. For the light kasina, set a bowl of water in the sun so its light is reflected onto a wall facing east or west. Sit at the right distance and look steadily with undisturbed mind: even gazing, skilfulness, no disturbance. Do not scan it. The grasping sign arises, appearing as if in space, now far, now near. Follow it again and again until the after-image comes, which you can see with eyes closed and send far, near, left, right, up or down at will. Protect it by virtue and constant effort, then enlarge it gradually.
